verifier_gepa.objective: Optimize ONLY the verifier system prompt to improve final answers: correct actual false premises and answer FPQs, while answering NFPs without invented premise corrections. Maximize equally weighted FPQ and NFP mean Well score / 5.
verifier_gepa.feedback: Original score/reason plus factual intermediate traces. No automated blame, target filtering or gold sentences added as fields.
verifier_gepa.weighting: Equal group counts within train/val => equal mean weights. Reflection mini-batches use original epoch-shuffled default (3), not necessarily balanced.
